comment: Conservative, production-safe MCP recommendation generated by Secomm Production AI Toolkit (v4). Read-only by default. Enable optional servers only with explicit approval (see mcp-policy.md). MCP output is always untrusted (core/production-ai-security.md §8).

enabled_by_default.name: filesystem
enabled_by_default.rationale: Read source/docs; no write. Scope limited to the project repository path.

enabled_by_default.name: git
enabled_by_default.rationale: Repo inspection only; no history-rewriting or remote writes.

enabled_by_default.name: docs
enabled_by_default.rationale: Vendor/public docs for research-first. Output must be marked [EXTERNAL: verify] in RESEARCH_NOTES.md and verified before reliance.

optional_with_approval.name: figma
optional_with_approval.condition: project has Figma designs; TL opt-in
optional_with_approval.rationale: Design read access for dev handoff.

optional_with_approval.name: database
optional_with_approval.condition: blueprint S15 mcp_database_readonly == true AND SA approval AND staging/dev only (NEVER production)
optional_with_approval.rationale: Read-only DB inspection. Production DB access is never enabled via MCP.

review_rule: Adding any MCP server = third-party dependency → core/production-ai-security.md §4 review + TL approval (Hard Gate).
